sections.title: Overview
descriptions: Officer Philip W. S. Craig worked for the American Fork Police Department from May 2018 through October 2021.

Craig began working for the Utah County Sheriff’s Office in October 2021. This page includes his background and employment information, as well as records concerning his involvement in the 2021 Janene Thorpe encounter.

sections.title: Background
descriptions: Officer Philip William Starlin Craig was born on April 8, 1994. He is from American Fork, Utah, and graduated from American Fork High School in 2012. In June 2015, he married Amber Bardin, who now goes by Amber Craig.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Philip W. S. Craig worked for the American Fork Police Department from May 1, 2018, through October 2, 2021. During that employment, he was involved in the April 23, 2021, Janene Thorpe encounter. The Thorpes later named Craig as a defendant in a federal lawsuit filed in April 2023.
Craig began working for the Utah County Sheriff’s Office in October 2021. Public compensation records from 2022 through 2025 indicate that he continued working there through at least 2025.

sections.title: Related Police Encounters
descriptions: Officer Philip W. S. Craig was involved in the Janene Thorpe encounter alongside Officer Christopher Slate Blackburn. Craig was named as a defendant in the federal civil lawsuit subsequently filed by the Thorpes.

The folder below contains links to YouTube videos showing body-camera footage of the encounter, documents from the Thorpes’ lawsuit, and records from related civil cases involving the Thorpes and their neighbors.
